protocol.purpose: Historical development backtests, not an untouched research test: 2026 outcomes already appeared in full-pool diagnostics.
protocol.selection_rule: Choose model/settings using historical backtests only; freeze before any Swiss 2026 outcomes. Do not describe the earlier September Elo test as untouched.
protocol.unknown_missing_games: Provisional source series and publication times remain limitations. No claim of official complete-series recovery.
protocol.target_context: Unknown future map side is excluded from deployable inputs or marginalized under a documented pre-draft selection model. Conditional-on-realized-side diagnostics are separate from tournament forecast evaluation.
protocol.historical_prior_policy: Only records available before each fold may inform priors or preprocessing. Earlier team effects are season-specific. Cross-season regional bridges must be reviewed and specified before fitting.
protocol.temporal_specification: Not finalized; requires discussion before fitting a temporal variant.
protocol.uncertainty: Do not treat games from the same series as independent replicates for confidence intervals. Model posterior uncertainty is distinct from evaluation sampling uncertainty.
protocol.prospective_evaluation: The frozen post-draw Worlds 2026 Swiss forecast is evaluated separately once outcomes occur, without updating its initial predictions.

pending_audit_reviews: Cross-season region transitions and historical team priors are not yet specified or fitted.
Forecast boundary is chosen; announcement timestamp is decoded from its URL, not independently retrieved.
Publication timing and source UTC/seconds conventions are not verified.
limitations: Candidate training sets are for inspection; open event/identity/model-bridge reviews must be resolved before fitting.
No probabilities were fitted or scored; this report contains sample counts and membership only.
Historical 2026 outcomes were already inspected in diagnostics, so these are development backtests, not pristine research holdouts.
Within each future fit, priors, decay, feature construction, and preprocessing must use training records only.
Models stay frozen through each event; no within-event result updates are allowed by this protocol.
Publication delay is assumed and series groups are provisional; those limitations persist in this plan.
